purpose: Original research and methodology for an idealized Motala decision-support model. A catalogue entry does not mean the PDF has been downloaded or its parameters validated locally.

sources.title: Regional Economic Growth and Municipal Financial Planning: An Application of a System Dynamics Model to Calgary
sources.webVerification: PDF readable through research browser; 31 pages. Not a local download.
sources.reviewScope: Abstract, scope, structure, calibration and limitations
sources.modelUse: Reference for municipal stocks, flows, feedbacks and delays.
sources.limitation: Calgary's revenue institutions and fitted parameters do not transfer directly to Motala. Historical fit does not establish superior forecast accuracy.

sources.title: Konjunkturläget mars 2024
sources.webVerification: Current PDF readable through research browser; 80 pages. Not a local download.
sources.reviewScope: Demografisk framskrivning av kommunal konsumtion, printed page 44, repeated on page 78
sources.modelUse: Reference for age-weighted service demand, staffing and separate volume/price assumptions.
sources.limitation: National methodology, including regional services; restrict our model to municipal responsibilities and calibrate Motala separately.

sources.title: Ausgabenseitige Effekte der demografischen Entwicklung auf die Kommunalfinanzen
sources.webVerification: Publisher's open-access PDF link followed; 31 pages readable through research browser. Not a local download.
sources.reviewScope: Abstract, study scope and cost-persistence discussion
sources.modelUse: Motivates testing fixed costs and delayed capacity adjustment when service demand falls.
sources.limitation: German municipal evidence; neither coefficients nor service responsibilities can be assumed to match Sweden.
